Presented By:

Happy Tuesday! *Bitcoin* is holding its local range near $77,500 despite rising oil prices and *Fed* rate hike bets, with analysts ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-01-bitcoin-defies-oil-price-spike-and-rising-fed-hike-bets-after-best-august-since-2017-413218?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) seeing resilient dip-buying after its best August since 2017.

In today's newsletter, *Ethena* launches *Ethena Pay* on *Avalanche* , *Strategy* hits back at *MSCI's* latest proposal, *Payward* partners with the *London Stock Exchange* on tokenization, and more.

Meanwhile, *Ark Invest* bought ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-01-ark-invest-buys-37-million-block-413195?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) $37 million worth of shares in *Jack Dorsey’s Block*.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Strategy* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*🚀 Ethena launches Ethena Pay app on Avalanche, offering up to 6% yield and 10% cashback*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/web3/2026-09-01-ethena-pay-app-avalanche-yield-cashback-413225?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Ethena Labs* , the team behind the synthetic dollar project *USDe* , launched the beta of *Ethena Pay* , a self-custodial money app built on *Avalanche* and rolling out across 48 countries.

* Ethena founder *Guy Young* called it the first neobanking app vertically integrated with a stablecoin issuer's own product, rather than relying on *USDC* or *USDT* , letting users hold USDe as a dollar balance and move money via IBAN, crypto, or bank transfer.
* The app enables "instant fee-free transfers" by username and USD, EUR, and GBP bank transfers, with other transfers carrying 0.05% to 0.1% fees.
* The app offers rewards including up to 6% APY on balances and up to 10% cashback at select brands like Uber, Spotify, and Claude.
* U.S. and EU markets are excluded at launch but are expected later during the beta, coming after German regulator BaFin ordered Ethena to wind up its USDe business there in 2025.

Bringing global finance onchain



 
Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
